This is a press source, so 'strong' is OK. | The RoadtoVR article by Ben Lang is dated November 27, 2023 and covers the announcement. FCC shows no 'Space Pro' name, 7,000 mAh battery or STC end date. | fccid.io lists 2A5NV-B3110 and 2A5NV-AA1Z0 ('Mixed Reality Computer') with application date 2026-09-01.
